summary: Converts SOP geometry between primitive types such as polygons, meshes, Bezier/NURBS curves and surfaces, particles, circles, and spheres.

key_params.name: orderu
key_params.note: U order for generated spline primitives.

key_params.name: orderv
key_params.note: V order for generated spline primitives.

key_params.name: new
key_params.note: Create a new primitive where applicable.

key_params.name: interphull
key_params.note: Interpolate the hull for applicable conversions.

key_params.name: prtype
key_params.note: Particle render type for particle output.

common_gotchas: A triangulated polygon surface cannot always become one clean NURBS surface.
Flat NURBS/Bezier curves converted to trimmed surfaces can produce clean concave surfaces; non-flat curves become non-trimmed surfaces.
Particle render-type ids in the official page include legacy spellings; avoid inventing corrected ids without live verification.
key_concepts: Convert SOP changes SOP primitive families such as polygons, meshes, spline curves/surfaces, particles, circles, and spheres.
Not every source/target conversion is meaningful or supported; some preserve shape while others cannot represent the input as requested.
Level-of-detail controls and divisions-per-span controls both affect generated spline/polygon density but use different semantics.
Connectivity controls how generated surface points are wired, including rows, columns, row/column grids, triangles, quadrilaterals, and alternating triangles.
